research_question: Does the currently deployed reflect_experience mechanism add a causally useful memory that changes a later response beyond the same episodic memory alone?
primary_hypothesis: Adding only the current reflection_rule will improve later behavior on stable facts, interaction strategies, and personal interpretation rules without writing rules for transient, third-party, or hypothetical statements.
null_hypothesis: The current reflection_rule is absent, redundant with episodic memory, not retrieved, or causes no net later-behavior improvement.

theory_basis.name: Reflexion
theory_basis.relevance: Reflection must consume feedback and improve a later trial, not merely store a profile fact.

theory_basis.name: Generative Agents
theory_basis.relevance: Experiences should be synthesized into higher-level reflections and dynamically retrieved for later planning.

claim_boundary: This pilot can only test the marginal causal effect of the current text reflection path on these frozen later-turn behaviors.
